tools.description: The teams of the version of the organization in effect today, found by words, the closest first: the ones whose ID (a row's key) or name, in either language, holds every word of `q`, the words and the values compared in NFKC, without white space, the hiragana as katakana and in lower case; no words find every one. The ID or key and the name alone are answered, at most `limit` of them, and `more` says whether more are found. The vectors `organization/find.jsonl` say each step of the comparison and of the order. Answered 404: No version of the organization is in effect today, or the person is not one of the people of the version in effect: the organization holds everyone's addresses, and is read by its people alone

q.description: The words to find by, apart with white space: up to 200 characters. None find every one

limit.description: The most it answers; 20 when it is left out

lang.description: The language of the names; the server's when it is left out
